title: Spanish, B.A. (College of the Liberal Arts)
notes: Entrance to major requires a 2.00 GPA and third-semester classification, not modeled directly. New span_catalog.json (SPAN 1/2/3/100/100A/100B/200/200A/215N/253W). SPAN 1->2->3 is a strict linear prereq chain; SPAN 100 (standard track, used here) and SPAN 100A/100B (heritage-speaker/medical-Spanish tracks) run in parallel, each gated on SPAN 3 or placement, not on each other -- per the bulletin's own note that heritage/native speakers take SPAN 100A/200A instead of the standard sequence. SPAN 215 has no unsuffixed catalog entry -- only SPAN 215N (Gen Ed Inter-Domain) and SPAN 215Q (Honors) exist; modeled as an OR-pool. SPAN 100C and SPAN 100H, cited as prereq alternatives for SPAN 215N/253W, could not be confirmed as standalone courses (absent from the department's full listing, appearing only inside other courses' prereq strings) -- not modeled, documented in span_catalog.json. '200-/300-level SPAN courses' (5 occurrences), '400-level SPAN literature', '400-level SPAN linguistics', and 'three 400-level SPAN courses' (3 occurrences) are modeled as generic slots, matching the bulletin's own open-range phrasing. 'LA 283' (the same unconfirmed code hit throughout recent Liberal Arts builds) replaced with a generic slot. Re-verified against the bulletin's own program-requirements PDF (spanish-ba_programrequirementstext.pdf) for a real handbook-depth pass. Confirmed SPAN 215/253W and SPAN 200/100 modeling is correct (SPAN 215N/215Q share the exact bulletin title 'The Science of Spanish...', confirming they ARE the bare 'SPAN 215' the bulletin cites, just under its Gen Ed-tagged course codes -- not a bug). Found that all 4 previously-generic elective pools ('200-/300-level SPAN Course' x3, '400-level SPAN Literature Course', '400-level SPAN Linguistics Course', '400-level SPAN Course' x3) actually correspond to the bulletin's own real, exactly-enumerated closed lists -- wired up with the real course codes instead of unfillable placeholders: the 9cr Supporting 200-/300-level list (SPAN 220/297/299/300/300B/305/314/315N/316/353/355/356/397/399 -- SPAN 210 and SPAN 354 omitted, stale/unconfirmed codes not in span_catalog.json, same convention as RUS 400), the 3cr '400-level Hispanic Linguistics' list (SPAN 411/417/418/497), the 3cr '400-level Hispanic Literature' list (SPAN 439/470/472/474/476/479/488/490/491/497), and the 9cr 'additional 400-level' list (SPAN 410/411/412/413/417/418/420/439/470/472/474/476/479/488/490/491/497/499).
